Boutique shops, local markets

The Palm House by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Right in the heart of Old Seagrove and a quick stroll from Seaside, this stylish, sun-drenched retreat has everything you need to settle into a slower pace. The private backyard is basically its own mini resort, the ultimate people-pleaser. Pure memory-making bliss, the outdoor oasis features a heated pool that begs for cannonballs, a spillover spa, a cozy lounge with a fireplace and big TV, and a summer kitchen that’s grill-master approved. Shaded seating nooks invite early morning coffee or evening cocktails, while games like ping pong and corn hole keep the good times going. Perfect for everything from lazy afternoons to lively dinners. But be careful, it’s the kind of space that might just keep you from ever visiting the beach. Step inside and spread out. The home is bright, airy, and thoughtfully arranged across two breezy levels.

The open living space is perfect for movie nights, snack feasts, or just flopping on the couch after a long day of beach-hopping. Each bedroom is its own comfy hideaway with en suite baths for that little touch of “ahhh.” And if the weather keeps you inside, no worries! The house comes stocked with board games, a solid library, Hulu, Disney+, and enough entertainment to keep the crew happy. Oversee 30A is proud to manage The Palm House. As a local team, help is always close if you need it, with 24/7 support if anything pops up. So pack your flip-flops, and get ready to turn vacation mode all the way on. We’re here to make sure your stay runs smoothly. Overview: - Absolutely no pets, no exceptions - 0.4 miles to Dogwood, Thyme Beach Access (Call Coastal Beach Service For Personal Beach Chair Services) - 1 mile to Santa Clara Regional Beach Access with parking (4 min golf cart ride) - 2,518 sq ft - Complimentary six-seater golf cart - Resort-style backyard with heated pool, spillover spa, fireplace, television; summer kitchen - Private pool w/ spillover spa (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - 5 parking spots - Natural gas grill - Wi-Fi - Hulu Live and Disney+ available on all TVs - 5 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bath, TV - Bunk Area: Full over full bunk bed with trundle, shared bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
